process.title: From first enquiry to finished order
process.intro: A clear sequence keeps every order predictable — from the brief to the packed garments.

steps.title: Enquiry
steps.text: You send your requirements through the quote form or contact us directly.

steps.title: Requirements
steps.text: We clarify tasks, working conditions, quantities and sizes.

steps.title: Model and fabric
steps.text: Models, fabrics, colours and logo placement are selected.

steps.title: Sample
steps.text: A sample is prepared so the garment can be assessed before production.

steps.title: Approval
steps.text: You confirm the sample, size range and order details.

steps.title: Cutting
steps.text: Fabric is marked and cut according to the approved patterns.

steps.title: Sewing and branding
steps.text: Garments are sewn and finished with embroidery or print where required.

steps.title: Quality check and handover
steps.text: Finished items are inspected, packed and handed over.
